page_title: UNI 1-0 WOL | Union Berlin v Wolfsburg 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
90+5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+5' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+5' The whistle blows and Pavao Pervan (Wolfsburg) is booked for an infringement.
90+3' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+1' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+1' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Union Berlin continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
90' A clumsy foul by Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle. Union Berlin will take a free kick near the side line.
89' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
87' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

87' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
85' Yellow card. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
85' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Frederik Ronnow punches the ball away.
82' The game has come to an end for Robin Gosens. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Kral leaves the pitch and Paul Jaeckel (Union Berlin) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Mattias Svanberg is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
80' It's time for a substitution. Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Rogerio.
78' A lofted cross from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
75' The resulting corner from Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is cleared.
74' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Kevin Paredes is replaced by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg).
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
73' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
73' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) has come on for Benedict Hollerbach.
69' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
69' Pavao Pervan (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg win a corner kick.
68' The corner from Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is hurriedly cleared.
65' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

64' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Frederik Ronnow displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' Union Berlin take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
62' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
61' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
59' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a change. Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) replaces Andras Schafer.
59' The substitution is prepared. Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin Volland.
59' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.

59' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
58' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
56' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
54' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
54' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
53' 6:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
49' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

47' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed just over the crossbar!
46' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Union Berlin.
46' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Moritz Jenz will be replaced by Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg).
46' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+28' The match has reached half-time.
45+27' Niko Kovac is stunned as referee Matthias Jollenbeck shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
45+26' 1 - 0 The score has changed – 1:0. Kevin Volland sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) jumps highest and plants a header inside the left post.
45+24' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+24' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
45+22' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.

45+22' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) commits a foul after dangerous play. Wolfsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45+20' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Frederik Ronnow has no trouble gathering it.

45+20' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it. Wolfsburg get a corner.
45+20' The resulting corner from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+20' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. Wolfsburg win a corner.
45+19' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+18' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
45+15' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
45+10' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) takes it short.
45+9' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
45+6' Half-chance! Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) plays a pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45+4' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' We will have 21 min. of added time.
45' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
45' The game is interrupted.
43' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
40' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
39' The match can continue after the interruption.
28' The game is interrupted.
26' Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to intercept the corner from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg).
25' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
23' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
21' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

20' A pass out of defence finds Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) in space, he doesn't think twice and releases a shot from long range which flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
19' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
17' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthias Jollenbeck no option but to blow his whistle.
11' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
10' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Union Berlin have a corner.
10' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
8' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
8' A cross from Alex Kral (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
7' The attendance for today's match is 22000.
6' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
6' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him.

3' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
2' Rogerio (Wolfsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will referee today's match.
